verdict.rationale: Mercury documents self-service control over card spend limits ("Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls" and API support to "manage spending limits"), which lets an admin set/adjust limits directly rather than submit a request for approval. There is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'request a transaction/credit limit increase' self-service screen or approval workflow. Missing for 10: explicit UI/flow for submitting and approving a limit-increase request, confirmation this applies to overall account/credit limits (not just per-card spend caps), and independent/hands-on verification of the flow.
